final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT Name, rate, track_count, rate - mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean FROM media_rates CROSS JOIN overall_mean WHERE rate > mean_rate ORDER BY Name
